Trump's slightly improving approval rating comes as the GOP continues to struggle against the Democrats in a generic congressional ballot. According to the newest poll, Democrats continue to hold an advantage of 6 percentage points over Republicans ahead of November’s midterm elections.

Tuesday’s The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted Aug. 21-24 among 1,536 U.S. adults. The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.

## More bad polling for Trump? [...] Tuesday’s The Economist/YouGov poll came only a day after the president got less-than-stellar news from the newest Reuters/Ipsos poll released Aug. 24.

And it’s not the only poll illustrating the diminishing relative appeal of Republicans. As of Aug. 3, the polling average from election data organization Decision Desk HQ shows the Democratic Party holds a 6.7-point lead over the GOP on a generic congressional ballot.
